itle: Romans 3:21-26 -  Lesson 5

TAKEAWAY
All people can access righteousness from God through faith in Christ.



DIVISION 1 — God’s PROVISION of righteousness BY FAITH for sinners. (Romans 3:21–24)
                                                                             Principle
Faith in Jesus Christ is the only path to a right standing with God.

Application Question
In what ways might you struggle to accept that God’s salvation plan only requires faith in Christ?


DIVISION 2 — God’s JUSTIFICATION BY FAITH for sinners. (Romans 3:25–26)
                                                                              Principle
God’s love provided Jesus as the sacrifice to justify believers.  
                                                                          Application Question
What upside-down reality do you struggle to live out in your life? (Reigning through serving, Strength through weakness, Being made rich by being poor, etc)
